name: freezone
description: Monorepo: freezone-api (Express), freezone-web (Vite admin+legacy storefront), freezone-storefront (Next.js).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.db:local: npm run db:up --prefix freezone-web && npm run db:setup --prefix freezone-api
scripts.ci:freezone: npm run lint --prefix freezone-web && npm run test --prefix freezone-web && npm run build --prefix freezone-web && npm run build --prefix freezone-api && npm run test --prefix freezone-api && npm run routes:check --prefix freezone-api && npm run build --prefix freezone-storefront
